name: Lazy Betty
dinnerNote: Tasting menu, 8 courses, service included (bar menu $185)

menus.name: Lazy Betty Tasting Menu
menus.note: Prices include a 20% service fee; Elevated wine pairing $265, non-alcoholic pairing $125; A5 wagyu course $95 extra

menus.name: Vegetarian tasting menu
menus.note: On request; prices include a 20% service fee; non-alcoholic pairing $125

menus.name: 4 Course Tasting Menu
menus.note: Bar and lounge only, no reservations; also offered as a pre-theatre menu; prices include a 20% service fee

menus.name: Dessert Tasting Menu
menus.note: Bar and lounge only, no reservations; prices include a 20% service fee

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable. Reservations are for the tasting menus in the dining room only.
walkIns: The four-course bar menu and the dessert tasting menu are served only in the bar and lounge, first come, first served, for parties of up to four.
groups: Three private spaces: the Chef's Room for up to 20, the Private Dining Room for up to 30 (the two can be joined), or the whole restaurant for up to 100.
children: Children are expected to eat a tasting menu; the kitchen can make a modified one if asked ahead.
duration: About three and a half hours.
byob: Corkage is $75 per 750ml bottle, two bottles at most, and not for wines on the list.
